lines.text: I've watched the seasons come and go
Through summer sun and winter snow
I've heard your laughter in these halls
I felt your fingerprints on my walls
I've heard your songs late in the night
And morning prayers in early light
And every time you close my door
I miss you till you're here once more
I'll leave the light on in the hall
So you can find your way through it all
My door is open, come on in
You're always safe from storm and wind
No matter where you choose to roam
You'll always have this place, this home
And when the road takes you away
I miss you more than words can say
High above, my window sees
Changing skies and bending trees
Watching roads that take you far
Listening for your familiar car
I know someday you'll walk back through
The door that always waits for you
Houses don't travel, we don't roam
We stay right here when you are gone
Through every year, through joy and tears
I'll still be here through all the years
I am your place, I am your home
No matter where you choose to roam
These walls remember, these floors know
I'll be here when you need me most
So go and live and go and roam
I'll still be here when you come home
The fire is warm, the light is low
I'll be here when you need me most
No matter where your footsteps roam
You'll always have this house, this home
And when the road takes you away
I miss you more than I can say
